sample_unit: COVID-19 datasets (five datasets; patient counts not reported in text)
unlisted_practices: Self-supervised pretraining on unlabelled multimodal data to enable rapid adaptation to new diseases with limited labels
Replay of a past pandemic (retrospective and prospective Omicron variant) to test model adaptability to emerging disease

screen.reason: The study develops and benchmarks a new multimodal large language model (Med-MLLM) across multiple retrospective/replay datasets and clinical tasks (reporting, diagnosis, prognosis) without evaluating a health system deployment practice or safeguard.
